bullets.title: Preparing for Safe Clinical Procedures
bullets.text: Safe procedures begin before equipment is touched. The nurse should confirm the indication, assess the patient, explain the procedure, obtain consent, gather equipment and plan infection-prevention and safety measures.

bullets.title: Assessment, Monitoring and Clinical Measurement
bullets.text: Accurate measurement provides essential information about the patient's condition. Technique, interpretation and timely response are equally important. Recording a number without recognising its clinical meaning is incomplete nursing practice.

bullets.title: Infection Prevention, Aseptic Technique and Device Care
bullets.text: Many clinical procedures create a pathway for microorganisms to enter vulnerable sites. Hand hygiene, appropriate PPE and protection of key parts and key sites are essential during wound, catheter, intravenous and enteral care.

bullets.title: Medication, Mobility, Communication and Documentation
bullets.text: Clinical skills are integrated. Medication administration, mobility assistance, patient education and documentation all require safety checks, communication and evaluation.
